transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hello, doctor. Lately, I've been feeling really down, anxious, and overwhelmed, and I'm finding it very hard to cope. I just feel like I can't manage these emotions on my own anymore, which is why I decided to come in.
I'm sorry to hear you've been struggling. Could you tell me how long you have been feeling this way, and did these feelings start after a specific life event?
I've been feeling this way for about five months now. It started pretty suddenly, about a month after I lost my job and had to relocate.
During these past five months, have you experienced a persistent loss of interest in activities you usually enjoy, or have you had days where you felt completely normal?

Yes, it has been a constant struggle for the past five months, and I haven't really had any days where I felt completely normal. I've also definitely lost interest in the things I used to enjoy, because I'm just too overwhelmed and exhausted to care about them right now.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your sleep patterns or your appetite during these past five months?
To be honest, I haven't noticed any major changes in my sleep or appetite. My mind is usually just so occupied with feeling anxious and down all the time.

latest_inference.note: Previously the candidates were [Major Depressive Disorder, Adjustment Disorder]. While the symptoms were triggered by a life event (job loss/relocation), the severity and duration of the symptoms (anhedonia, constant struggle) are more characteristic of Major Depressive Disorder than Adjustment Disorder.
